claims.claim_text: Summer daytime land surface temperature over the Southeastern United States has risen

variable.name: Land surface temperature, daytime
variable.plain: How hot the ground and the tops of plants and buildings are, as seen from space in the early afternoon. It is not the same as the air temperature a thermometer reads in the shade.

product.name: MODIS Terra LST Day, monthly 0.05 deg CMG (MOD11C3)

ladder.label: Raw Mann-Kendall
ladder.changes: Start. Each cell tested on its own raw seasonal series, assuming the years are independent.

ladder.label: Seasonal anomalies
ladder.changes: Each cell compared with its own typical value for the same season before testing.

ladder.label: Hamed-Rao correction
ladder.changes: The test now allows for neighbouring years resembling each other (autocorrelation).

ladder.label: Benjamini-Hochberg, q = 0.10
ladder.changes: Controls the expected share of false alarms among the flagged cells, declared in advance.

regional.band_method: PLACEHOLDER: pointwise 95% band from a residual bootstrap of the Sen fit (independent residuals). The real method is decided by the stats worker.
